project_type: React + Vite SPA (TypeScript), pnpm workspace monorepo. Main app is under src/. An artifacts/electron/ directory contains a second workspace package with its own vite.config.ts, but the primary deployable SPA lives at workspace root (src/main.tsx -> vite.config.ts -> dist/).
build_system: pnpm v9 workspace. Build command at root runs typecheck then builds all packages. The main SPA builds from the root vite.config.ts (NOT artifacts/electron). manualChunks already splits react-vendor, graphics-vendor (ogl), map-vendor (maplibre-gl), and vendor.
test_framework: vitest (inferred from vite setup). Test files found as *.test.ts in src/. No dedicated test runner script found at root; typecheck via pnpm run typecheck.
build_command: pnpm -r --filter './' --if-present run build (or: npx vite build from project root using root vite.config.ts)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `pnpm run typecheck` - must pass with no errors. 2. Run `npx vite build` from /projects/sandbox/electron to confirm the build succeeds and inspect chunk sizes in dist/. 3. Manually check index.html for correct font-display, preconnect hints, and cache headers in netlify.toml/vercel.json.
setup_instructions: pnpm install is already done. Node/pnpm available at system level.
environment_constraints: Network is OPEN_INTERNET. No docker daemon confirmed needed - build runs via Vite on host. The root vite.config.ts is the primary build config (NOT artifacts/electron/vite.config.ts). The artifacts/electron/ subtree is a separate workspace package with its own vite config and src/ - do NOT confuse it with the root src/.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Key: use pnpm (not npm/yarn). TypeScript must pass. Preserve existing manualChunks pattern in vite.config.ts.
key_patterns: 1. Lazy loading: React.lazy used in lazyFeaturePanels.tsx (5 feature panels), AppWorkspaceShell (PlacesList), PlacesList (PlacesMap), App.tsx (MagicComponent/Moire, RetroEffects, ElectronLogoLab, CohesionAudit). 2. MoviesView is NOT lazy - it is the default/primary tab and eagerly imported in AppWorkspaceShell. 3. preloadAppModules.ts already preloads 12 modules during boot screen. 4. App.scss imports Cormorant Garamond via @import url() in addition to the 4 Google Fonts in index.html (Fredoka, Quicksand, Nunito, Space Mono). 5. motion/react used in MovieDeckStack and MoviesTopControls - these are in the main bundle. 6. gsap used in AppNavStrip and useCinematicEntrance. 7. lucide-react used in AppNavStrip, MessageBubble, MessageInput, MovieCard, MoviesTopControls, PlaceCard, PlacesTopControls, QuizEditor, BottomSheet. 8. Netlify.toml has NO caching headers. vercel.json has rewrites but NO caching headers. 9. Quiz photos: 12 PNG files in public/quiz-photos/, ranging from 100KB to 460KB (total ~3MB) - not optimized. 10. electron-logo-source.png is 1.3MB in public/.
directory_structure: / - workspace root with vite.config.ts (main SPA build), index.html, netlify.toml, vercel.json, package.json. /src/ - main app source (app/, components/, hooks/, services/, theme/, utils/). /public/ - static assets (quiz-photos/*, manifest.json, sw.js, icons). /artifacts/ - separate workspace packages (electron, electron-mobile, mockup-sandbox, api-server) - leave mostly untouched.
